recentItems.title: What comes after the industrial era of food? This is Food 3.0. | Christine Gould | TEDxBoston
recentItems.description: How did humanity move from saving seeds and fermenting food to producing enough calories for eight billion people? Food 1.0 worked with nature and laid the foundations for civilization; Food 2.0 harnessed science, fossil energy, and global trade to deliver productivity, convenience, and scale. But that achievement now carries an estimated hidden bill of $15 trillion a year in damage to human health and the environment. Food 3.0 offers a way beyond the old choice between small and sustainable or big and efficient—combining worms, microbes, and agroforestry with gene editing, AI, and sensors. Building it means widening the spectrum of people, knowledge, data and solutions we allow to shape agriculture’s future. Christine R. Gould is the founder and CEO of GIGA Futures, where she works at the intersection of science and technology, markets, policy and geopolitics to unlock new sources of growth across food, agriculture and the bioeconomy. Raised on a farm and trained in science and technology policy and security and defense economics, her career spans corporate strategy at Syngenta, technology commercialization with Flagship Pioneering portfolio companies, entrepreneurship and global policy. She previously founded Thought For Food, building it into a movement reaching more than 30,000 innovators across 180 countries and supporting over 100 startups. Christine has served on the UN Food Systems Summit Advisory Committee and is the author of “The Change-Maker’s Guide to Feeding the Planet." This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: The fascination of foraging fungi | Tyler Akabane | TEDxBoston
recentItems.description: How many fungi can you name? Have you ever foraged your dinner on a walk in the wood? Can you tell the difference between a deadly stalk and a delicious treat? To the untrained eye, these questions may sound difficult. Tyler Akbane argues we need more mushroom literacy to appreciate this potent and powerful ingredient. Despite similarities, a child can learn to recognize the difference between a shark and dophin with practice and context. He advocates for this kind of curiousity and exposure to open us all up to the magical world of mushrooms. Tyler Akabane is the founder of a New England-based mycology education and foraging enterprise, The Mushroom Shop, and one of the region's most recognized fungi educators. He began foraging and studying mushrooms more than 15 years ago and has since built a community of practitioners through guided foraging walks, workshops, partnerships with local farms and restaurants, and collaborations with sustainable packaging innovators using mycelium-based materials. He is part of a global movement that is repositioning fungi not just as food but as tools for environmental remediation, biodegradable material production, and community health. He studied music before discovering mycology and brings a sensory, experiential approach to science education. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: The People Who Know You Best May Have Never Met You | Diva Afi | TEDxITS
recentItems.description: We like to believe that our thoughts, preferences, and decisions are entirely our own. But what if the people who understand us best have never actually met us? As our lives become increasingly datafied, the traces we leave behind reveal far more than we realize. This talk examines how data can be used to uncover, predict, and influence human behavior and why understanding this reality is becoming essential in a personalized digital age Diva Afi Ayunda, widely known as Diva Afi, is a cybersecurity educator, founder of Wo-Men In Tech Security (WTS), and a Generation Connect Young Leadership Programme (GCYLP) Fellow of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU). Through education, digital advocacy, and community initiatives, she helps young people better understand technology, online safety, and the evolving relationship between humans and digital systems. Her work explores cybersecurity, digital trust, artificial intelligence, and the ways technology shapes human behavior and decision-making. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: Throw Away the Script | Nana Yaw Ofori-Atta | TEDxAshesi University
recentItems.description: The old blueprint for success (school, a respectable course, a safe corporate job) worked for our parents, but the world has since accelerated. This talk is about reading the script before you reject it, spotting which parts are broken, and writing your own story using adaptability and the one thing a machine can't copy: your perspective Nana Yaw Ofori-Atta is a Senior Brand Strategist at Brainstorm Africa and an independent recording artist known as Oneman1000. He has built a career at the intersection of creative strategy and music, developing brand identities for clients while releasing original music to a growing audience across streaming platforms. Before moving into brand strategy, he gained experience in sales and marketing at Stanbic Bank Ghana. His work sits at the crossroads of commerce and creative expression, and he continues to explore how strategic thinking and artistic instinct can inform each other. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: Misconceptions Exist Even in Medicine! | باورهای غلط حتی در پزشکی | Alireza Sadeghinikoo | TEDxKish
recentItems.description:
Even in a field built on science and evidence, misconceptions can persist and influence important decisions. Alireza Nikoo challenges common medical beliefs and invites us to question what we think we know about health and medicine. Dr. Alireza Sadeghinikoo is an Iranian medical researcher, pharmaceutical sciences professional, and science communicator. He has co-authored several peer-reviewed scientific publications covering sports medicine, pharmacology, exercise physiology, and health sciences, collaborating with international researchers.
He established and managed Oxygen Med, a sports medicine and athlete health center at Enghelab Sports Club in Tehran.
He is also the founder and host of MMA Farsi, combining scientific research, sports analysis, and public education to promote evidence-based thinking. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: The Role of Art and Artists at Pivotal Moments in Society | Omid Nemati | TEDxKish
recentItems.description: At critical moments in history, art can become more than a form of expression; it can shape conversations and influence society. Omid Nemati reflects on the responsibility of artists and the power of art during defining social moments. Omid Nemati is an Iranian singer, songwriter, and composer, best known as the lead vocalist and co-founder of Pallett, one of Iran’s prominent contemporary music bands. Born in Tehran, he studied Graphic Design at Soureh University. His musical style draws inspiration from traditional Persian music, folk, and contemporary sounds, often bringing classical and modern Persian poetry together. Beyond his work with Pallett, Nemati has pursued solo projects, including his album Deprivation. His artistic work explores the connection between music, poetry, and cultural identity. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: Todo cambia alrededor de nosotros | Sharon Dennis | TEDxTec de Mty Sonora Norte
recentItems.description: A través de experiencias de comunicación, activismo y bienestar animal, esta charla muestra cómo contar historias con propósito puede movilizar a la sociedad y generar cambios reales. Aunque los medios, formatos y herramientas cambian con el tiempo, se reflexiona sobre que el verdadero impacto nace de las emociones, la empatía y la persistencia, incluso cuando el camino implica cansancio, duelos o actuar detrás de escena. Emprendedora, conferencista y creadora de contenido enfocado en desarrollo personal, liderazgo y empoderamiento femenino. A través de sus proyectos y plataformas digitales comparte experiencias y herramientas relacionadas con crecimiento integral, mentalidad y autenticidad, conectando con comunidades interesadas en bienestar y transformación personal. Además, ha participado en iniciativas de comunicación y desarrollo profesional orientadas al impacto social y humano. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: Creer en ti mismo hace la diferencia | Jesús Gómez | TEDxTec de Mty Sonora Norte
recentItems.description: A partir de una experiencia de emprendimiento, incertidumbre y aprendizaje en entornos de innovación, esta charla reflexiona sobre cómo creer en uno mismo y pasar a la acción transforma la percepción de lo que es posible. Se abordan el valor de dar el primer paso, cambiar la relación con el fracaso, mantener firme el objetivo mientras se es flexible en el camino y animarse a pedir ayuda para construir realidades. Emprendedor fintech y fundador de Lounn.mx, plataforma enfocada en facilitar el acceso a financiamiento para empresas. Ha participado en eventos de innovación y emprendimiento en Hermosillo, además de formar parte de Shark Tank México, impulsando soluciones tecnológicas para el sector financiero. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: Las decisiones que nos cambian ocurren en silencio | Gerardo Bringas | TEDxTec de Mty Sonora Norte
recentItems.description: A partir de una experiencia personal de adicción, recuperación y reinserción cotidiana, esta charla reflexiona sobre cómo los cambios profundos suelen comenzar en silencio y mediante decisiones honestas más allá de buscar la perfección. Se abordan el valor de pedir ayuda, poner distancia de los entornos que frenan el cambio, sostener la sobriedad día a día y entender el éxito a partir de la dignidad y la reconstrucción personal. Director de Programa de Licenciatura en Estrategia y Transformación de Negocios en el Tecnológico de Monterrey, con trayectoria en liderazgo académico, consultoría empresarial y desarrollo organizacional. Es socio consultor en BCD Consultores, firma especializada en planeación estratégica, estructuración organizacional y desarrollo de talento humano, donde asesora a empresas y emprendedores en modelos de negocio y crecimiento empresarial. Además, ha sido docente universitario en áreas de innovación, dirección de negocios y emprendimiento, así como fundador y CEO de Anger & Fury Rooms, un concepto innovador de entretenimiento en Hermosillo. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: Decisiones pequeñas, vidas enormes | Eva Aldecoa | TEDxTec de Mty Sonora Norte
recentItems.description: A partir de la idea de que las grandes etapas de la vida se construyen con elecciones cotidianas y de que el amor por sí solo no basta sin estructura ni acción, esta charla invita a mirar hacia dónde nos llevan nuestras decisiones diarias. Entre experiencias de alto rendimiento, emprendimiento, historia familiar y salud mental, se reflexiona sobre la importancia de salir del piloto automático, contar con las herramientas adecuadas y construir una vida de la que no se quiera escapar. Especialista en bienestar emocional y desarrollo humano, reconocida por su trabajo en temas de salud mental, inteligencia emocional y autoconocimiento. Ha participado en distintos espacios de formación y acompañamiento enfocados en ayudar a las personas a mejorar su calidad de vida y fortalecer su bienestar integral. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: No somos lo que nos pasa | Thali Garcia | TEDxTec de Mty Sonora Norte
recentItems.description: Partiendo de la idea de que no somos lo que nos ocurre sino lo que elegimos hacer con ello, esta charla recorre experiencias de resiliencia, responsabilidad temprana y reinvención ante la adversidad. A través de cambios drásticos, pérdidas, sacrificios familiares y nuevos comienzos, se invita a soñar en grande, sostener la propia agencia y construir una vida con propósito más allá de las circunstancias de origen. Actriz, conductora y figura pública con trayectoria en televisión y medios digitales. Ha participado en producciones reconocidas y se ha convertido en una voz cercana para miles de personas gracias a la manera en que comparte experiencias sobre crecimiento personal, resiliencia y autenticidad. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

recentItems.title: El que quiere, puede | Fernando Rodriguez | TEDxTec de Mty Sonora Norte
recentItems.description: A partir de una experiencia de sobrecarga laboral y un episodio de salud que obligan a replantear prioridades, esta charla narra un recorrido itinerante llevando atención dental gratuita a distintas comunidades. Entre imprevistos, encuentros humanos y lecciones compartidas en el camino, se reflexiona sobre la escucha consciente, la adaptabilidad frente a los contratiempos, el equilibrio personal y el poder de la vocación de servicio. Empresario y líder enfocado en el desarrollo de negocios y estrategias de crecimiento. A lo largo de su trayectoria ha trabajado en proyectos relacionados con liderazgo, innovación y formación de equipos, destacándose por su visión emprendedora y capacidad de adaptación. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
